title: 第3章 长溪子爵
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

属于人境巅峰武士的旺盛气血，在这一刻被调动，化作澎湃的气力，施展出家传的武技。

铜剑竭力刺下，剑鸣声宛若蛟龙嘶吼，没入大鱓的天灵，直直将整把剑的剑身刺入其中。

大鱓的身体猛地绷直，随后如断了线一般，重重地砸在滩涂上。

尾巴还在抽动，但已是强弩之末。

杨戬走上前来，又补了一刀。

这回彻底不动了。

“呼——“祁澜拔出铜剑，长长地吐了一口气，平息着身上涌动的气血。

剑刃上全是血和黏液，铜剑的锋口也崩了两个小豁口。

人境巅峰到底不是凡境，这柄铜剑能撑到现在已是不错，但也快到极限了。

“澜兄，你这几剑，耍得真心漂亮。“

杨戬把三尖两刃刀扛在肩上，走了过来，语气里带着真心实意的赞叹，“还有在那泥地里走步子，果真灵活。”

“踏川步，据说是大禹王传下来的禹步修改而成，最善行舟踏水，闪转腾挪，配上我长溪部祖传擒蛟手的路数，用剑使出来，便是这般效果。“

祁澜取出麻布，将铜剑表面擦拭干净，看着瘫软在沙滩上大鱓尸身，顿了顿，又道：

“二郎此番出力甚多，若无你在，光我几人，说不得要受些伤。”

这大鱓凶猛非常，在场长溪部中，只有他这个人境巅峰武士具备直接正面抗衡的能力，其他人虽然也是人境武士，但气力较他还是差了一大截，也就到了人境后期的老默能多撑一会。

而有了杨戬这个人神混血，天生神力的数值怪在，帮他正面牵制了这大鱓相当多的一部分压力，否则还真没这么容易斩杀。

“这大鱓一身血肉筋骨，都是颇为难得的宝材，照此前商议好的，此行功成，你我两家，一人一半。”

“客气，澜兄，你我什么关系，你家也已经够照顾我家了，还是照着老规矩，将这大鱓尸身送去你那儿，请匠师处理，我就取我家能用的那部分血肉，剩下的筋骨爪牙，我家用不上，换成钱币财帛便可。”

杨戬摆了摆手。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The strong energy and blood belonging to the peak human realm warrior was mobilized at this moment, turned into surging energy, and displayed the martial arts inherited from the family.

The bronze sword stabbed down with all its strength, and the sound of the sword was like the roar of a dragon. The Heavenly Spirit submerged in Dalu, piercing the entire sword body straight into it.

Da Er's body suddenly straightened up, and then hit the beach heavily as if a thread had been broken.

The tail was still twitching, but it was at the end of its strength.

Yang Jian stepped forward and made another stab.

This time he was completely motionless.

"Huh -" Qi Lan pulled out the bronze sword and took a long breath to calm down the surging energy and blood in his body.

The blade was covered with blood and mucus, and the edge of the copper sword also had two small cracks.

After all, the peak of the human realm is not the mortal realm. It is good that this copper sword can last until now, but it is almost reaching its limit.

"Brother Lan, you are really beautiful with these swords."

Yang Jian put the three-pointed two-edged sword on his shoulder and walked over, with sincere admiration in his tone, "And walking in the mud, it's really nimble."

"The Chuanbu Step is said to be a modification of the Yu Step passed down by King Yu. It is best for rowing boats, treading water, and jumping around. It is combined with the ancestral method of catching dragons from my Changxi tribe and is used with a sword. This is the effect."

Qi Lan took out the linen cloth and wiped the surface of the bronze sword clean. He looked at Da Yi's body lying limp on the beach, paused, and then said:

"Erlang has done a lot of work this time. If you hadn't been here, I wouldn't have been injured."

This Dalu is extremely ferocious. Among the Chang Xi tribe, only he, a peak human realm warrior, has the ability to directly confront it. Although the others are also human realm warriors, their strength is still far inferior to him. Only Lao Mo, who has reached the late human realm, can hold on for a while longer.

And with Yang Jian, a human-god hybrid, and the numerical value of his natural divine power, it helped him to contain a considerable part of the pressure of Da Qi, otherwise it would not be so easy to kill him.

"This Dalu is made of flesh and bones, which are quite rare treasures. According to what was discussed before, this trip is a success, and each of you and I will get half of it."

"You're welcome, Brother Lan, what's the relationship between you and me? Your family is already enough to take care of my family. I'd better follow the old rules and send this body to you and ask a craftsman to handle it. I'll take the part of the flesh and blood that my family can use. The rest of the muscles, bones, claws, and claws that my family can't use can be exchanged for money and silk."

Yang Jian waved his hand.
